role_summary: Automates how software is built, shipped and run: CI/CD pipelines, containers, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, monitoring and incident response.

postings.title: DevOps Engineer (Observability)
postings.summary: Platform engineer leading observability systems (logs, metrics, traces and profiling) for a microservice environment on AWS and Kubernetes.
responsibilities: Lead architecture and delivery of observability platform components
Unify logs, metrics, traces and profiling into clear workflows
Build tooling and APIs for incident response and debugging
Advise and mentor teams across the platform organisation
requirements: Proven experience building observability systems at scale
Proficiency in Go, Python or Java
Experience with telemetry tools such as Prometheus, OpenTelemetry or Kafka

postings.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer (CI/CD & Delivery)
postings.summary: SRE on the delivery team running large-scale cloud services: Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD and GitOps, SLOs, incident response and automation.
responsibilities: Design, build and operate large-scale cloud services
Lead incident response and post-incident reviews
Define and improve SLIs, SLOs and error budgets
Automate toil and improve deployment safety with CI/CD and GitOps
requirements: Operating large-scale production services on AWS and/or GCP
Deep production Kubernetes experience, including troubleshooting
Software development in Go or Python
